name: expandable-gallery
title: Expandable Gallery
description: A row of equally sized image panels fills the width. Hovering one lets it grow to three times its share while the others narrow, with a slow ease.
use: A page wants a compact row of images where one can be previewed larger on hover.
avoid: Hover is the only trigger, so touch and keyboard users cannot expand a panel.
a11y: Panels expand on hover only, so keyboard and touch users get no enlargement, and alt text is just the URL. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five tall nature photos sit edge to edge in a single rounded row, each the same width. A small caption sits above, and hovering one stretches it wide while the rest squeeze thinner.
behaves: At rest the panels share the row equally. On hover the pointed panel grows and its neighbours shrink, easing over half a second; moving away restores the even split.
customise: images (URLs) and className are the only props; the fixed height, gap and three-times hover growth are in the source.
weight: light: Five image panels with a single CSS flex transition; no script.
